title: 독립유공자예우에 관한 법률에 의한 가족관계등록 사무처리규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
title_original: 독립유공자예우에 관한 법률에 의한 가족관계등록 사무처리규칙
full_text:
Article 3 (Application Procedures)
(1) The Administrator of the National Veterans Affairs Agency shall submit an application for permission to create a family relations register to the Seoul Family Court.
(2) When determining the place of registration of a person of distinguished service to independence, the Administrator of the National Veterans Affairs Agency shall reflect the wishes of any surviving family members of that person, if such family members exist.
(3) An application for permission to create a family relations register shall be accompanied by written verification by the National Veterans Affairs Agency that the person concerned is a person of distinguished service to independence and by an official investigation report prepared by that Agency.
(4) An application for permission to create a family relations register shall be accompanied by a certificate of absence of registration issued by the head of the relevant Si (Gu), Eup, or Myeon in which the family relations register is to be created; an identification statement prepared in accordance with the method of recording family relations registers; evidence of the person's birth and death; and, where the parents are to be recorded, supporting evidence concerning the parents.
